(333)༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga'i lha lnga gtso bor bsdus pa'i man ngag bla ma gong ma'i phyag len

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (333)༄༅// rgyud sde lnga'i lha lnga gtso bor bsdus pa'i man ngag bla ma gong ma'i phyag len

bzhugs so// (334)oṃ swa sti/ dkyil 'khor ma lus kun 'dus pa// ye shes rnam lnga'i ngo bo nyid// de la gus pas phyag btsal nas// de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad// de la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rnams nas/ gzhi lus bde mchog lhan skyes dang*/ dgyes mdzad lhan skyes la sbyar ba ci rigs pa yod cing*/ bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la yang ci rigs su mdzad pa gnyis ka ltar rung zhing yid ches can yin no// des na 'dir bde mchog lhan skyes la brten nas rnal 'byor bshad par bya ste// de la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ nang mchod mchod gtor sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas/ skyabs 'gro sems skyed spyi dang mthun par byas nas/ nang mchod gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud ma lus pa sbyangs nas/ slar 'dus te 'od du zhu ba thig ler gyur/ de las rang nyid la 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ 'og phyogs su chad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūm̐ spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dang*/ de las 'phros (335)pa'i ra gur du gyur cing hūm̐ las hūm̐ dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur bas bar mtshams med par gtams/ nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu zhu ste/ ra gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/

ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum bya/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste/ me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang tshogs zhing dbyer med du gyur/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do// oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te chos thams cad stong pa nyid do// zhes mnyam par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan/ de'i steng du byang sems zla ba hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams mnyes (336)par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ he ru ka yab yum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ hūm̐ yig rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim pas yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga in+d+ra nī la ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang*/ ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu'i tshogs dang*/ ska rags dang*/ mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/

stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// (337)yab kyi sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i yon tan gyi ngo bo rang dang mtshungs pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum/ bde chen 'khor lor sku gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po yid tsam khros pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang mtshungs kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o// longs spyod 'khor lor gsungs ma hā mā yā mthing ga phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo rang mtshungs la 'khyud pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la mi ro mnan pa'o// chos kyi 'khor lor thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje mthing ga phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa'o// bde skyong 'khor lor phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i zhal can phyag gnyis kyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pas yum phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/

skra ser gyen du brdzes shing dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa/ g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la ma he mnan pa'o// yang na thams cad hūm̐ las bskyed kyang rung bar bshad do// rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i gtso 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po// thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar (338)lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gsang mchod de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa yid kyis dran tsam bya/ de nyid lnga pas bstod pa'am/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ che ba'i mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug ma// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rab rdzogs pa/ dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa gtso bor bzla zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+ri kra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhrī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang ci rigs bzla'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams thig ler zhu ba dang*/ de yi 'od zer gyis lus gang ba sogs spro bsdu la sems 'dzin par bshad cing*/ gtso bor chos drug nyid bsgom pa yin no// mthar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing cung zad mi rtog pa la mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang nyid he ru ka yab rkyang gi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me'i steng du a las ka pā la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba hūm̐ bh+rūṃ oṃ ཿdz+riṃ khaṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan drangs te bstim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ gong du bshad pa'i snying po rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog / gi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod (338) gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o// gal te dgyes mdzad lhan skyes la brten nas bsgom par 'dod na/ gzhi lus dgyes mdzad lhan skyes nyid du byed pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin brlabs kyi rjes su skye mched drug byin rlabs bya/ bzlas pa yang de wa pi tsu badz+ra gtso bor byed pa rnams khyad par ro// phyi'i dkyil 'khor lha lnga'i tshul bsgom par 'dod na/

pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi shar du gsang 'dus/ lho ru dgyes mdzad/ nub tu mā yā/ byang du 'jigs byed/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la bum thod bzhi gsal 'debs/ phyi dkyil du bsgom pa'i yig rnying phal che ba na/ gtso bor gsang ba 'dus pa la byas pa nyid mang ba yod na'ang*/ rang gang la mos pa nyid gtso bor byas pas chog /de bzhin du yig rnying 'ga' na phyi dkyil 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga la brten pa'ang yod do// shin tu zab pa'i sgrub thabs 'di// khyung po rnal 'byor la sogs pa// de nyid mkhyen pa'i phung gi don// ngag 'don tsam du bsgril ba yin// ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra na thas smras pa'o// sarba dza ga taṃ/
